english-en introduction to gender and sexuality

the title of the text is "introducing english-en: introductiing the language, society and culture of the english speaking countries", because our aim is to be introductory in this regard to our country, to the people and the language, in general. we believe that this introduction needs to go beyond this "general introduction" to better explain the difference between british and american english, and english as a language (eal), of canada and the usa.

the introduction will take us to the history of the english language, from the middle ages through the industrial revolution, of the period from the 16th to the 20th centuries, and to the present. the first part of the introduction will explore the main characteristics of british english, specifically gender and sexuality.

the second part will look at the historical development of american english, including our country's early days, and the language in its present form, in canada and the usa. both, the history and the development of our country, the english language, will be explored.
